title: objectives/scorecard@1 — vector value surface, NEVER a scalar (COG-3)
description: A vector scorecard (docs/plans/cognitive-core-phase-3-contract-2026-07-22.md §4.4, foundry :228-237): a mapping of named dimensions -> a per-dimension cell. There is NO aggregation function and NO aggregate property anywhere — no total, no composite, no weighted sum, no sort-by-fitness (P12 no-scalar ratchet; the query surface returns the full vector or nothing). One failed floor fails the vector regardless of the others (no compensatory logic). An absent `value` = unknown, and unknown NEVER passes a floor (:239 'missing evidence is unknown, never success'). Floors are per-dimension independent measures — NOT the forbidden aggregate. Registry-PATH-resolved but validated with jsonschema.Draft202012Validator.

additionalProperties.description: One per-dimension cell (:228-237). Absent `value` => unknown state.

value.description: The per-dimension measure; absent => unknown, never success

floor.description: The independent per-dimension floor; unknown never passes it

state.description: The per-dimension derived INTERNAL epistemic state (:239). Internal vocabulary ONLY — persisting the Captain word ('observed'/'tested'/'refuted') fails schema (§5.2 'no second drifting enum'); the Captain vocabulary appears solely at presentation via query.to_captain_word

evidence_binding_refs.description: The FULL belief-view reference tuples backing this dimension (confidence rides WHOLE with source_trust, never a bare scalar; §5.5)
